validates; the inf_exit_fn wall is gone). Battery through m3 is 0/45 — m3 traps
at runtime in flatten's acc ++ xs. Reproduced: ++ never grounds its operands

mentl/13e1c5d:
Land $lookup_row_for (lookup.wat) — the Hβ.lower.lookup-row follow-up: a TFun's
row field is a row-var HANDLE, chased through the graph like a type handle
(NRowBound→EffRow; NRowFree→Pure; resolved row values pass through).
derive_ev_slots now chases the row before reading its names — row resolution is
independent of value-type (NFre) resolution.

This sharpens the L1 activation root via a minimal-reproducible micro-test
(effect E; deep performs ping; mid calls deep; main installs h):
- The micro-test has NFre=0 (value types fully resolved) yet threads ZERO
  evidence. So Blocker 2 framed as "5015 type errors" was imprecise.
- Probing derive_ev_slots: the chased row resolves to Pure because the row
  handle is NRowFree (unbound). `deep` performs `ping` but its inferred
  function row is a free variable — the seed's inference never propagates a
  `perform op`'s effect (nor a callee's row) into the enclosing fn's row.

Precise gate (replaces the vague row-inference framing): the deep/mid micro-
test is the regression fixture. The remaining work is effect-row inference
proper — `perform`/call effect propagation + row-var binding in infer — after
which lookup_row_for resolves the row, derive_ev_slots sees the effect, and the
(committed, correct) evidence machinery threads it for singleton (graph) and
multi-handler (iterate) cases uniformly. Walkthrough §4.9.

tokensafe/13d82bd:
wSOL reported 94.5% sell tax — false positive caused by denominator
mismatch. fetchRoundTrip() uses 5M (5 USDC) for wSOL buys, but
analyzeHoneypot() divided loss by BUY_AMOUNT_LAMPORTS_BIGINT (100M).
Fix: thread buyInputAmount through JupiterRoundTrip → analyzeHoneypot.

Also removes dead code in liquidity.ts — fetchJupiterQuote() was never
called in production (checkLiquidity always receives a prefetched quote
from the orchestrator). The function duplicated jupiter.ts logic and its
tests created false confidence. Replaced with direct prefetched-quote
tests in both checks.test.ts and liquidity.test.ts.

New test/jupiter.test.ts covers fetchRoundTrip: wSOL special case
(USDC pair, 5M amount, correct buyInputAmount), normal token path,
sell-uses-buy-output, and failure modes.

198 tests (was 153), all passing.
perennials/13753c3:
--header-h was the single source of truth for how tall the fixed chrome is, and
adding a sticky filter bar silently invalidated every consumer of it. The rail
at >=48rem still offset against the header alone, so the bar covered its top
36px and its first control -- the 'Edible only' checkbox -- could not be clicked
at all: elementFromPoint returned the filter bar. Measured before: 36px overlap,
the tap lands on the bar. After: a 12px gap, the tap lands on the input.

Phone-only, but she may well open this on a laptop, and 'desktop-only' is not
'never'. Also lifts the header brand link to the tap floor -- the last sub-44px
target on the browse page.
